## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2006-04-14: Form-of TRA filed as Ex 10.2 to original S-1 (unexecuted)
- 2006-08-10: Up-C IPO; TRA executed between PubCo and Partners of Evercore LP
- 2006-08-11: Class A common stock begins trading on NYSE (EVR)
- 2006-11-07: Executed TRA filed as Ex 10.2 to Q2 2006 10-Q

#### Liability buildup and TCJA remeasurement

- 2008-02 (FY2007 10-K): First TRA liability recognition of $37.6M from 2007 secondary-offering-related exchanges
- 2015-12-31: TRA contractual obligation peaks at $202.08M
- 2018-02 (FY2017 10-K): TCJA enacted December 22, 2017 cuts federal rate from 35% to 21%; TRA remeasured downward by $77.535M to $103.20M (valuation change, not amendment)

#### Ongoing runoff

- 2026-02 (FY2025 10-K): YE2025 contractual obligation $69.84M; FY2025 cash payment $11.37M; no amendments or terminations across the firm's 20 annual reports

## Explanation

Evercore Partners Inc. (renamed Evercore Inc. effective July 27, 2017) executed its sole Tax Receivable Agreement at the August 10, 2006 Up-C IPO close, paying 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 basis adjustments arising from exchanges of Evercore LP Partnership Units for Class A common stock, plus imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The contract has never been amended, restated, or terminated across twenty annual reports; the 2011 Lexicon Partners acquisition and 2025 Robey Warshaw acquisition added no TRA beneficiaries. The TRA contractual obligation built up to a peak of $202.08M at YE2014 as Senior Managing Directors exchanged units in successive secondary offerings, then remeasured downward by $77.535M in December 2017 when the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act dropped the federal corporate rate from 35% to 21%. The TRA has paid out steadily at $9-13M annually since 2013 and stood at $69.84M at YE2025; the FY2025 cash-flow schedule shows payments continuing through at least 2035. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the year-by-year payment and obligation history.
